label: def:color-tube-coordinates
title: Color tube coordinates
html:
Definition. Color tube coordinates

Let z = x_0/x_1 \in \mathbb{P}^1(\mathbb{C}) be the spacetime ratio (braid group action(i)) and let w_k, k \in \{0,\dots,4\}, be the Lagrange resolvents of Bring's surface (Lagrange resolvents). The color tube coordinates are the shifted spectral coordinates

\begin{equation}\label{eq:color-tube-coords}
  c_r = w_2 - z, \quad c_g = w_3 - z, \quad c_b = w_4 - z,
\end{equation}

together with the space-like shift \sigma = w_1 - z. The color vector is c = (c_r, c_g, c_b).
